data.title: Senior Nurse - ICU Unit
data.fitReason: Direct 4-year ICU nursing experience with demonstrated patient care competency in multi-specialty hospital. Meets core clinical requirements and readiness for senior nursing position within current hospital environment.

data.title: Nurse Training Coordinator
data.fitReason: Proven experience training new nursing staff demonstrates capability to develop standardized training programs and mentor junior nurses. Clinical background supports credibility with training audience.

data.title: Clinical Nurse Supervisor
data.fitReason: 4 years clinical experience with training responsibilities provides foundation for supervisory role. Lacks formal management certification but demonstrates leadership capacity through mentoring and patient care coordination.

data.title: Hospital Patient Care Manager
data.fitReason: Healthcare record management and patient care experience aligns with patient care coordination duties. Multi-specialty hospital background provides understanding of complex patient workflows and care pathways.

data.title: Emergency Response Nurse
data.fitReason: Documented emergency/first aid response capability ('so cap cuu') and ICU experience qualify for emergency department or rapid response team roles. Proven ability to function in high-acuity environments.

data.title: Healthcare Records Administrator
data.fitReason: Demonstrated proficiency in medical information systems and healthcare documentation ('quan ly ho so y te'). Clinical background ensures understanding of record requirements and compliance standards.

data.title: Nursing Unit Coordinator
data.fitReason: Patient care communication skills and administrative documentation experience support coordination between clinical and administrative functions. Training experience indicates organizational capability.

data.title: Clinical Quality Assurance Nurse
data.fitReason: ICU patient care experience and training responsibilities provide foundation for quality monitoring role. Healthcare records management indicates understanding of compliance and documentation standards.

data.title: Patient Safety Officer
data.fitReason: ICU experience and emergency response training demonstrate understanding of high-risk patient care environments. Clinical background supports credibility in patient safety initiatives and incident reporting.

data.title: Healthcare Facility Operations Assistant
data.fitReason: Multi-specialty hospital experience and administrative documentation skills provide foundation for operations support role. Patient care background supports understanding of facility workflow requirements.
